CASCADE_PERMS_V14.CascadeHint: Apply the selected permission changes to every document in this folder and its sub-folders.
CASCADE_PERMS_V14.CascadeNote: Only selected permission values are changed. “No Change” leaves that entry untouched; “Default” removes that user's explicit override.
CASCADE_PERMS_V14.ResetHint: Reset all contained documents to inherit permissions from their parent folders.
CASCADE_PERMS_V14.ResetNote: Destructive: removes every explicit per-user override and sets the document default to Inherit. This reset takes precedence over the selected values.
CASCADE_PERMS_V14.SuccessCascade: Cascade Permissions: updated {count} document(s) across {folders} sub-folder(s).
CASCADE_PERMS_V14.SuccessReset: Cascade Permissions: reset {count} document(s) to parent-folder inheritance across {folders} sub-folder(s).
CASCADE_PERMS_V14.NoDocuments: Cascade Permissions: no documents found in this folder tree.
CASCADE_PERMS_V14.NoChanges: No permission changes were selected. Use the reset option to clear all overrides.
CASCADE_PERMS_V14.ErrorCascade: Cascade folder permission: operation failed. Check the browser console (F12).
CASCADE_PERMS_V14.PartialError: Cascade folder permission: updated some documents, but {failed} failed. Check the browser console (F12).
